audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-2 were backwards. Both layers read Skill / Kayle / Kayle for levels 1, 2 and 3 while the whys say melee Kayle 'can't punish you', has 'no answer' to the level-2 root, and that you 'still out-grind her' at 3. The packet chart reads Maokai, Maokai, Skill. Row 4 read Skill in both layers though whys[4] says the window swings to her.
audit.why: Pre-transformation Kayle is a short-range melee with no dash and no waveclear; Maokai's W-Q root chain plus Sap Magic is uncontested there. The mirror (kayle__maokai) already set its rows to Maokai / Maokai / Skill / Skill / Kayle.
audit.corrected: Row 0 -> Maokai 6/10, row 1 -> Maokai 7/10, row 2 -> Skill (rating unchanged), row 4 -> Kayle (rating unchanged). Rows 3, 5, 6 already correct. Paired full+content edits, one atomic group. Phase whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page framed the lane around 'Divine Judgment's cooldown windows' at every stage, including levels 4-5 when she does not have an ultimate. The real spike order is her transformation and first item, not her R.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s — a per-fight get-out, not a lane rhythm. Her actual threat curve is melee form (helpless) -> ranged form + first item (out-ranges your 525 W) -> two items (kites forever).
audit.corrected: phases[3].why, phases[4].why, phases[5].why, phases[6].why, tldr, winCon, enemyWin and breakdown.mid rewritten around the transformation clock with the 160s and 525 numbers in.
sources: enemyKit P text (gains Attack Range as she levels)

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment was described only as 'her get-out at 6'. The page never stated that it makes the target invulnerable, which is precisely what blanks your W root follow-up and a Nature's Grasp kill setup. Kayle's W heal (Celestial Blessing, flat 15s) was referenced only as vague 'his healing'.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Kayle makes an ally invulnerable' — that is the interaction that decides whether your R is worth spending. The 15s heal cooldown is what your anti-heal timing is actually racing.
audit.corrected: Stated in report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, phases[4].why and the itemization anti-heal line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kayle referred to as 'his'/'him' across the full layer while the content layer correctly uses 'her'.
audit.why: Mixed pronouns on the same matchup page read as unedited template text.

edits.before: Passive heal + AA trades carry the early waves. Identify how Kayle contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Melee-form Kayle cannot punish a step-up — Sap Magic out-sustains her level 1, so contest the first wave and deny last-hits.

edits.before: W root is your engage AND your peel — spend it once per fight. Only take the trade when Kayle's Divine Judgment is down.
edits.after: Twisted Advance roots her and Bramble Smash knocks her back — a melee Kayle with no dash has no answer to the level-2 all-in.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kayle must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Your root chain still out-grinds her, but she is edging toward ranged form — the stage is now about how hard you deny CS.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Divine Judgment's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: She has no ultimate yet — keep repeating W-Q trades on your 11-12s W and crash waves so her ranged form arrives as late as possible.

edits.before: Nature’s Grasp roots whole teams — lane it only for kill windows. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kayle's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is a 160s invulnerability at rank 1 — it blanks your gank burst and W lockdown, so bait it before you spend R.

edits.before: Heartsteel is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Divine Judgment's cooldown.
edits.after: Ranged-form Kayle at one item out-ranges your 525 W and kites you — Heartsteel buys HP, not answers.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Kayle carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in she waveclears with E and kites you forever. Carry threat 9.5/10 — you are teamfight CC only, so end it before this.

edits.before: Both scale — W-root her early, deny her CS. Maokai wins the Divine Judgment cooldown windows.
edits.after: Kayle scales, you do not — W-root her in melee form, deny CS, close it before her ranged form.

edits.before: Deny her early and out-sustain her. Track Divine Judgment before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Deny her CS in melee form and out-sustain her with Sap Magic. Every wave she farms speeds her ranged form — shove it.

edits.before: Kayle wins by landing Divine Judgment, denying your pattern, and kiting you off the wave.
edits.after: Kayle wins by surviving melee form, reaching ranged form, and kiting your 525 W forever.

edits.before: Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 — bait it, then commit the kill.

edits.before: Track Kayle's Divine Judgment (Invuln): Her get-out at 6. Bait it. When it is down — W-Q + R her.
edits.after: Divine Judgment (160/120/80s) makes her invulnerable — it blanks your W root and R, so bait it first.

edits.before: W-root Kayle the moment his answer is down, Q-knockback the follow-up, and let brush saplings tax his every path.
edits.after: W-root Kayle the moment she steps to last-hit, Q-knockback the follow-up, and let brush saplings tax her every path.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Divine Judgment: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade on your own W cooldown, not hers: melee-form Kayle has no answer to a root chain. Crash waves to delay her ranged form and starve her.

edits.before: That is Kayle's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: That is Kayle's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.

Radiant Blast and Starfire Spellblade still only appear as 'Q' and 'E' in the content layer; naming them would have blown the band on strings the mirror already rewrote well, so I left those.
